notes.title: Release 1 episode June 22 “Silhouettes”
notes.notes:
[u]The release of episode 1,[/u] [b]of the visual novel "Silhouettes" will be on June 22.[/b]
This event is very important for us, we have been through a lot!
No matter how many times it stops us, [b][u]WE WILL ALWAYS GO FORWARD.[/u][/b]
In the future, we will release other episodes of the visual novel, but their development will depend only on you!

Follow the information about the visual novel in the community [url=https://web.telegram.org/a/#-1001971350265]telegram.[/url]

Lady luck [u](developer)[/u] was with you.
